source_omega_role_reconstruction.do_not_infer: The 2x2 ωR matrix itself is the entrywise complex conjugate of 2x2 ωL in every displayed basis. Only author-written coefficient conjugation is asserted.

reality_guard_negative_control.lesson: Complex ωT^1 violates author's SIX REAL coefficient domain; do not promote chiral-conjugation identity to arbitrary complex coefficients.
